boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, map-listed destinations on practical campus-adjacent corridors, each with one directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Gold Lot A
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor, beside UMD
cards.notes: Use the College Street entrance when arriving by car for a campus visit; UMD directs prospective visitors to this Gold Lot.
cards.short_summary: A named visitor-parking destination at the College Street campus edge.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD directs campus visitors to park in Gold Lot A, off College Street and University Drive.
cards.access_notes: Follow UMD visit-program parking instructions; parking arrangements depend on visit status.

cards.title: QDOBA Duluth
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor — 1020 Woodland Ave
cards.notes: Choose a customizable bowl, burrito, taco, salad, or nachos at the Woodland Avenue location, then take it to go or dine in.
cards.short_summary: A directly documented customizable-meal stop on Woodland Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: QDOBA’s official Duluth page lists customizable bowls, burritos, tacos, salads, and nachos at 1020 Woodland Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dine-in, takeout, delivery, and online ordering.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies Duluth
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor — 1016 Woodland Ave
cards.notes: Check the official locator before heading over for cookies; the company’s Duluth job listing identifies this as its Woodland Avenue store.
cards.short_summary: A named cookie-shop destination on the Woodland Avenue campus corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies’ Duluth job listing identifies its store at 1016 Woodland Avenue in Duluth.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies — Duluth Cookie Crew listing
cards.access_notes: Confirm current store hours through the official store locator before visiting.

cards.title: Shops at Bluestone
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor — 1220 Woodland Ave
cards.notes: Use this named retail center as a single stop for several documented storefronts, including Starbucks, QDOBA, Jimmy John’s, and Pizza Hut.
cards.short_summary: A named Woodland Avenue retail center near both UMD and St. Scholastica.
cards.evidence_claim: Duluth News Tribune identifies Shops at Bluestone at 1220 Woodland Avenue and lists its current storefronts.
cards.source_title: Duluth News Tribune — New businesses coming to Shops at Bluestone
cards.access_notes: Individual storefront access and prices vary.

cards.entity_name: Crisp & Green at Shops at Bluestone
cards.title: Crisp & Green at Shops at Bluestone
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor — Shops at Bluestone
cards.notes: Use the Shops at Bluestone stop for a fast-casual salad option; local reporting identified Crisp & Green as an incoming tenant there.
cards.short_summary: A documented fast-casual salad destination in the Woodland Avenue center.
cards.evidence_claim: Duluth News Tribune reported that Crisp & Green was joining the Shops at Bluestone at 1220 Woodland Avenue.
cards.source_title: Duluth News Tribune — New businesses coming to Shops at Bluestone
cards.access_notes: Confirm the tenant’s current availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Jimmy John’s at Shops at Bluestone
cards.title: Jimmy John’s at Shops at Bluestone
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor — Shops at Bluestone
cards.notes: Use the named sandwich-shop stop within Shops at Bluestone when you need a quick food option along the Woodland Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A documented sandwich-shop destination within the campus-adjacent retail center.
cards.evidence_claim: Duluth News Tribune lists Jimmy John’s among the businesses at Shops at Bluestone on Woodland Avenue.
cards.source_title: Duluth News Tribune — New businesses coming to Shops at Bluestone
cards.access_notes: Confirm current service and ordering options with the business.

cards.title: Starbucks at Shops at Bluestone
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor — Shops at Bluestone
cards.notes: Use this documented Shops at Bluestone storefront for coffee or other café drinks while staying on the Woodland Avenue campus corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named coffee-shop stop in the Woodland Avenue retail center.
cards.evidence_claim: Duluth News Tribune lists Starbucks among the businesses at Shops at Bluestone on Woodland Avenue.
cards.source_title: Duluth News Tribune — New businesses coming to Shops at Bluestone
cards.access_notes: Confirm current hours with the business before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Pizza Hut at Shops at Bluestone
cards.title: Pizza Hut at Shops at Bluestone
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor — Shops at Bluestone
cards.notes: Use the named Pizza Hut storefront at the Woodland Avenue center when planning a pickup or a meal with a group.
cards.short_summary: A documented pizza-shop destination within Shops at Bluestone.
cards.evidence_claim: Duluth News Tribune lists Pizza Hut among the businesses at Shops at Bluestone on Woodland Avenue.
cards.source_title: Duluth News Tribune — New businesses coming to Shops at Bluestone
cards.access_notes: Confirm current ordering and service options with the business.

cards.entity_name: At Sara’s Table Chester Creek Café
cards.title: At Sara’s Table Chester Creek Café
cards.subtitle: East 8th Street corridor — 1902 E 8th St
cards.notes: Plan a sit-down food stop on East 8th Street; UMD’s Duluth guide names At Sara’s Table Chester Creek Café among local dining options.
cards.short_summary: A named café destination on the East 8th Street corridor below campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s Explore Duluth guide includes At Sara’s Table Chester Creek Café in its dining list.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current menu, hours, and seating directly with the café.

cards.title: Tischer Creek
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor — near 1220 Woodland Ave
cards.notes: Pause at the creek corridor beside Woodland Avenue and use the city planning map to orient yourself to the mapped Tischer Creek watercourse.
cards.short_summary: A named natural feature documented beside the Woodland Avenue retail corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: A City of Duluth planning map labels Tischer Creek beside the 1220 Woodland Avenue area.
cards.source_title: City of Duluth Planning Commission packet map
cards.access_notes: Observe from public areas and follow any posted property or trail restrictions.
